reran: cmd.sh on w3-int, w3-base and the 2.13.18 jar: identical; (Int.MinValue to 51).lastIndexOf(3, 1073741823) and indexOf(3, Int.MinValue) return -2147483645. 2.13.0 and 2.13.1: same.
user_impact: Only a Range with more than Int.MaxValue elements (whose length already throws) searched with an explicit end, or with a negative from. lastIndexOf with the default end throws from length, and indexOf with the default from returns -1, so the common calls are safe.
fixability: clear cut: keep the position in Long in posOf and return -1 when it does not fit in Int. No compatibility cost. Belongs on #555, which already rewrites this line.
regression: in 2.13.0 (posOf is 9fab9723b9, 2.13.0-RC1; 2.12 used the generic search)
links: LI1 (#555): same line; widen that pull request.
note: Accurate as written. On the base the same number comes from Int wrap-around rather than from narrowing, so 'on_base: same' holds for the output though not for the mechanism. Whether to return -1 or throw as length does is a small choice; -1 matches indexOf with the default from today.
